direct.instructions: Prefer short definitional, simplification, constructor, and exact proofs.

automation.instructions: Explore appropriate Lean tactics and library automation; avoid placeholders.

structural.instructions: Look for introductions, cases, induction, rewriting, and intermediate facts.

critic.instructions: Rank candidate proof patches by likely Lean success. Include every candidate ID exactly once. Do not assert proof success.

decomposer.instructions: Convert theorem/hypothesis context into a claim graph, formal obligations, a subgoal DAG, and proof tasks. Keep IDs stable and dependency edges explicit.

reporter.instructions: Summarize completed runs from trace artifacts only. Do not change verification status.
